The prayer sought for herein is for a writ of Mandamus, directing the first respondent to dispose of the representation dated 30.08.2022 and refer the claim of the petitioner to the Arbitrator under the National Highway Act.

2. As against the compensation awarded against the petitioner for land acquisition proceedings for the benefit of the National Highways Authority of India, the petitioner had given an arbitration appeal dated 30.08.2022 to the first and second respondents and in order to decide the said arbitration appeal on merits at an earlier date and decide the same, the petitioner has moved the present writ petition.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 3.
Heard Mr.P.Sathish, learned Additional Government Pleader appearing for the first and second respondent and Mr.Su.Srinivasan, learned Standing Counsel appearing for the third and fourth respondent.

4. Learned counsel appearing for the respondents would submit that, though it has been addressed to the first respondent, a copy of the 3G(5) application, i.e., the arbitration appeal filed, since also has been marked by the second respondent District Collector, the District Collector / second respondent, since is an arbitrator within the meaning of Section 3G(5) of the National Highways Authority of India Act, the said arbitration appeal would be decided by the District Collector on merits and in accordance with law within a time frame that may be stipulated by this Court.
5.

That there shall be a direction to the second respondent viz., District Collector /
Arbitrator to decide the arbitration https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis appeal filed by the petitioner dated 30.08.2022 on merits and in accordance with law and pass final orders thereon within a period of twelve weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of N.Shobana vs Authorized Officer And The Special on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/59163195/
